power_domains_summary.HBA_core: Digital logic supply for the AHCI register block + per-port DMA engine + Command List walker; per host-SoC PDK (typ 0.9 V - 1.2 V).
power_domains_summary.PHY_analog: Analog supply for SATA Transport / Link / PHY macro per port; per PHY vendor (typ 1.0 V - 1.2 V core + 1.8 V - 3.3 V IO).
power_domains_summary.PHY_VDDIO: IO ring supply for SATA differential pair termination + driver bias.
power_domains_summary.DEVSLP_IO: Sideband IO supply for DEVSLP driver (AHCI 1.3.1); implementation-defined.

link_power_states.name: Active
link_power_states.description: L0 — fully active link; FIS exchange in progress; PxSSTS.IPM=1h.

link_power_states.name: Partial
link_power_states.description: Low-power link; receiver maintains COMRESET / COMINIT detection; exit latency ≤ 10 µs typical; PxSSTS.IPM=2h.

link_power_states.name: Slumber
link_power_states.description: Lower-power link; longer exit latency ≤ 10 ms typical; PxSSTS.IPM=6h.

link_power_states.name: DevSleep
link_power_states.description: Lowest-power link; PHY can be powered down; entered by host asserting DEVSLP sideband (AHCI 1.3.1); PxSSTS.IPM=8h.

host_pci_power_states.name: D0
host_pci_power_states.description: Fully on; AHCI memory + configuration accessible; interrupts enabled.

host_pci_power_states.name: D3HOT
host_pci_power_states.description: Configuration space accessible; memory-mapped registers not accessible; interrupts blocked. D1 and D2 are NOT supported per AHCI 1.3.1 PMCAP rules.

power_up_sequence: 1. Platform power rails come up; PERST# released (PCIe-style).
2. HBA enters H:Init; resets GHC.AE / GHC.IE / IS to reset values; GHC.HR self-clears.
3. PCI enumeration assigns BAR5 / ABAR; CMD.MSE + CMD.BME set by software.
4. If CAP.SAM=1, GHC.AE is RO 1; otherwise software sets GHC.AE=1.
5. For each implemented port: software programs PxCLB / PxFB; sets PxCMD.FRE=1; sets PxCMD.SUD=1 if CAP.SSS=1; sets PxCMD.ST=1.
6. PHY runs OOB → speed negotiation → L0; device sends signature D2H Register FIS; PxSSTS.DET=03; PxTFD.STS.BSY=0.
7. Software issues commands by setting PxCI[slot] (+ PxSACT[slot] for NCQ).

low_power_modes_summary.Aggressive_Link_PM: PxCMD.ALPE + PxCMD.ASP let the HBA auto-transition to Partial / Slumber when the port goes idle (CAP.SALP=1).
low_power_modes_summary.Automatic_Partial_to_Slumber: PxCMD.APSTE + CAP2.APST cause the HBA to transition from Partial to Slumber after a vendor-defined idle window.
low_power_modes_summary.Aggressive_DevSleep: PxDEVSLP.ADSE + CAP2.SADM cause the HBA to auto-assert DEVSLP after PxDEVSLP.DITO idle timeout.
low_power_modes_summary.Clock_gating: HBA may internally clock-gate the per-port DMA engine when PxCMD.ST=0 + PxCI=0.
low_power_modes_summary.HBA_D3: Host-bus PCI PM transitions HBA to D3HOT; register memory inaccessible until D0.

rows: PHY can be powered down; exit per PxDEVSLP.DETO (nominal 20 ms, max 255 ms) [AHCI 1.3.1]

devsleep_power_envelope.PxDEVSLP_DITO: Software-programmed idle timeout (ms) before DEVSLP auto-assertion (ADSE mode).
devsleep_power_envelope.PxDEVSLP_DM: DITO multiplier — extends max DITO to 16 × 16368 ms.
devsleep_power_envelope.PxDEVSLP_MDAT: Minimum assertion time (nominal 10 ms, min 1 ms).
devsleep_power_envelope.PxDEVSLP_DETO: Maximum exit timeout from DEVSLP de-assertion to device-ready (nominal 20 ms, max 255 ms).
devsleep_power_envelope.PxDEVSLP_DSP: Set by platform when the device + connector + host support DEVSLP.
devsleep_power_envelope.CAP2_DESO: When 1, HBA may only assert DEVSLP from Slumber state (PxSSTS.IPM=6h).

fields.notes: Section 8 (Power Management Operation) is normative; defines Power State Mappings (Figure 19 — Power State Hierarchy), Interface Power Management (Active / Partial / Slumber), Device D1/D2/D3 mappings (not supported for AHCI HBAs), PME, and DevSleep (Section 8.5, new in AHCI 1.3.1).
